internal.title: Accounting Service Kafka Consumer Lag Incident - Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:28 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high Kafka consumer lag in the accounting service, indicating a backlog of 5200 records. Diagnosis confirmed a queue backlog and elevated latency as contributing factors. Error injection was ruled out due to low error rates. The issue was mitigated by disabling the kafkaQueueProblems flag at 11:47 UTC, which led to recovery and normalization of consumer lag metrics. The incident is now resolved.

Timeline:
- 11:28: Alert received
- 11:47: Diagnosis confirmed queue backlog
- 11:47: Flag kafkaQueueProblems disabled
- 11:47: Recovery verified

Action taken: Disabled kafkaQueueProblems flag to clear backlog.

Please monitor Kafka consumer lag metrics closely to prevent recurrence.
